title: Airworks
description: Create based Modpack with focus on Create Aeronautics
body:
![Drill](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d3627e6d3ade8bb00aa196da934c0088f1a44d6e.jpeg)

Build, automate, and take flight. This modpack expands the mechanical brilliance of Create into a fully realized aerial engineering experience. With a strong focus on **[Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics/versions)**, you’re no longer bound to the ground—design moving airships, flying factories, and skyborne contraptions that truly exist in the world.

Harness rotational power, construct dynamic machines, and push your creativity into the third dimension. Whether you're building massive industrial networks or exploring the skies in your own handcrafted airship, this pack is all about motion, freedom, and innovation.


🛠️ What Makes This Pack Unique?

Unlike traditional tech packs, this experience focuses on physicalized machines—your builds aren’t just blocks, they move, function, and live in the world.

💡 Recommended Settings
For the best experience and stable performance, it is recommended to allocate at least **6 GB of RAM** to the modpack. Larger worlds, airships, and complex contraptions may benefit from additional memory depending on your setup.
